name: José Almeida
action: José shifts his weight off his aching knee, glances toward his satchel, and says, "I'll come this Sunday, but I'm not promising every week. What time?"
reason: His immediate response is a provisional yes: he trusts Olavo's musical ear and feels the pull of the old sambas, but his deep aversion to recurring commitments and his bodily fatigue make him avoid agreeing to every Sunday. Asking the time keeps the door open for a single visit while protecting his unclaimed afternoon and autonomy.
